parsed.why: No criminalisation, working hate-crime law and largely accepting society, but oversight bodies repeatedly document unremedied birth-sex custody placement, isolation and strip-search exposure, plus 64% trans discrimination prevalence and border ID friction.

No anti-trans statute and progressive rulings, but implementation lags: documented public-space discrimination and frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people, rising official hostility, and thin working recourse.

Sodomy statute carrying 14 years, sporadically enforced; police documented as a main source of violence against trans people, abuse continuing even when reported, with impunity and no trans-specific protection.

State itself hostile: 2024 law bans gender-affirming care, gender-marker change and public gender-identity expression; hate-crime law unenforced, police homophobic, assemblies violently attacked with victims arrested.

No criminalisation; facilities access, discrimination and hate-crime protections in force with high public support. Only negative is a first-reading rollback of resident-facing self-ID and school rules — a climate signal, not a visitor exposure.
